# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 34 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_016_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 16

**1** Jesus said: "Perhaps [маше] people think that I have come [еі] to cast [нопт] peace [еірнн] upon the world [космос]. They do not know that I have come to cast divisions [мерісмос] upon the earth — fire [кавс], sword [сhфе], war [поле мос].

**2** For there will be five in a house: three will be against two and two against three, father against son and son against father.

**3** And they will stand as solitary ones [монахос]."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *еірнн*: peace; Greek loan-word εἰρήνη
- *мерісмос*: division; Greek loan-word μερισμός
- *сhфе*: sword; native Coptic
- *полемос*: war; Greek loan-word πόλεμος
- *монахос*: solitary one, monk; the key Thomas term for the transformed individual — they will stand alone
- The triad fire/sword/war echoes Saying 10's fire; here the division is social
- cf. Matt 10:34-36; Luke 12:49-53 — the closest Synoptic parallels
- Thomas's version adds *monachos* ("solitary ones") as the final resolution — those who achieve singleness even amid division
